anbieter.admin: Sign in with a password (for everyone who administers)
vergessen.text: Enter your email address. You’ll get a link to set a new password.
vergessen.ohne-mail: No email sending is set up for this installation. Ask the person who administers Ablago to create a new link for you in user management.
vergessen.gesendet: If there is an account for this address, an email is on its way. The link in it is valid for one hour.
code.text: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
code.text.wiederherstellung: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.
code.wechsel.wiederherstellung: No phone at hand? Use a recovery code
code.verbraucht.titel: Signed in with a recovery code
code.verbraucht.text: This code is now used up. Have you lost your phone or got a new one? Set up two-factor sign-in again under My account → Security, or create new recovery codes.
zweifaktor.text: For your role a second step is required in addition to the password: a code from an app on your phone – or a passkey. Set up one of them now; it takes a minute.
zweifaktor.oder-passkey: or add a passkey instead of the app
zweifaktor.pflicht.hinweis: Because you may administer Ablago, you can also withdraw the requirement:
zweifaktor.pflicht.knopf: Turn off the requirement for administrators
zweifaktor.pflicht.frage: Turn off the requirement for everyone who may administer?
zweifaktor.pflicht.frage.text: Anyone who may administer then signs in with just the password again. Nobody else is affected. You can set up two-factor sign-in later under My account → Security.
passwort.willkommen.name: Welcome, {name}
fehler.falsch: Email address or password is wrong.
fehler.anbieter.unbekannt: There is no account in Ablago for {email}. Ask the person who administers Ablago to create one for you.
fehler.abgelaufen: The sign-in has expired. Please start again with the password.
fehler.passwort.kurz: The password needs at least {anzahl} characters.
fehler.email: Please enter a valid email address.
fehler.link.abgelaufen: This link has expired or has already been used. Please request a new one.
fehler.link.ungueltig: This link is no longer valid.
fehler.link.benutzt: This link has already been used.
passkey.fehler.https: Passkeys work as soon as Ablago can be reached over HTTPS.
passkey.fehler.zu-viele: You already have {anzahl} passkeys. Please remove one you no longer need first.
passkey.fehler.antwort: The device's response is too large.
passkey.fehler.abgelaufen: That took too long. Please try again.
passkey.fehler.ungueltig: The device did not confirm the passkey. Please try again.
passkey.fehler.doppelt: You have already added this passkey.
passkey.fehler.gleichzeitig: Your passkeys are being changed right now. Please try again.
passkey.fehler.viele: A lot of people are signing in right now. Please try again in a moment.
passkey.fehler.andere-adresse: For your account a passkey is needed after the password, and it only works at Ablago's address. Please sign in via {adresse}.
passkey.fehler.ohne-adresse: A passkey is required for your account, but Ablago no longer has a maintained HTTPS address. Please contact someone who administers Ablago.
passkey.fehler.pflicht-adresse: Passkeys can only be required once an address starting with https:// is entered under Workbench → Email and address. Otherwise the requirement could be bypassed via another address.
passkey.fehler.viele-adresse: A lot of requests have just come from this address. Please try again in a few minutes.
passkey.fehler.keiner: There is no passkey for this account here.
passkey.fehler.falsch: That passkey did not work. Please try again or sign in another way.
passkey.fehler.aus: Passkeys are not set up here.
passkey.fehler.letzter: A passkey is required for you. Add a new one first, then you can remove this one.
passkey.fehler.letzter.zweifaktor: Two-factor sign-in is required for you, and this passkey fulfils it. Add a new passkey or set up the code app first, then you can remove this one.
passkey.fehler.vertretung: While you are acting for someone else, their passkeys cannot be changed.
passkey.fehler.pflicht: Please add a passkey first (My account → Security).
passkey.oder-code: or with the code from the app
passkey.abgebrochen: Cancelled or timed out – nothing was confirmed. Please try again.
passkey.schon-da: There is already a passkey for you on this device.
passkey.adresse: Your device refuses the passkey for this address. Open Ablago at the address where you created the passkey.
passkey.zweiter.text: For your account a passkey is needed after the password. Confirm with your fingerprint, face or your device's PIN.
passkey.pflicht.text: A passkey is required for your role. From now on you sign in with your fingerprint, face or your device's PIN. It takes a minute.
passkey.pflicht.frage: Turn off the passkey requirement for everyone who may administer?
passkey.pflicht.frage.text: Anyone who may administer then signs in without a passkey again. Nobody else is affected. You can add a passkey later under My account → Security.
